Container.Name: Net2Net Local RADIUS Manager
Container.Overview: Local, per-WISP MikroTik PPPoE RADIUS manager. Stores data inside the mapped appdata folder. Exposes the web portal on 8080 and RADIUS authentication/accounting on UDP 1812/1813.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Persistent database, branding, and backups. Include this folder in Unraid backups.

Config.Name: Application secret
Config.Description: A unique random value, at least 32 characters. Never reuse it between WISPs.

Config.Name: Initial Super Admin password
Config.Description: Used only on the first start, when the database is empty.

Config.Name: Initial WISP Admin password
Config.Description: Used only on the first start, when the database is empty.

Config.Name: RADIUS shared secret
Config.Description: Must match every MikroTik /radius secret. Use a unique long value per WISP.

Config.Name: Private RADIUS client network
Config.Description: Optional private CIDR allowed to source RADIUS requests, for example 10.10.0.0/16. Leave blank to permit only registered router addresses.
